title: Muscat wind leads Brent intraday range
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Muscat max wind 20d z-score above 1 (rough Gulf of Oman seas) leads Brent intraday range higher by 2 days (+); trade long BZ=F volatility 3d [weather.muscat.wind_max -> finance.BZ=F.range_pct] (parent: R2-0011)

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.muscat.wind_max rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long BZ=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
